name: Plenum
description: A Plotform adaptation for a multi day congress: the programme is a real time grid with rooms across the top and time down the side, switchable by day and filterable by track, with talk, speaker, venue and practical pages around it. Drawn plans instead of maps, and no photography anywhere.
designNotes: Plotform adaptation of jekyll-theme-conference's structure, a multi day time grid with talk, speaker, room and venue pages, not an unchanged upstream template. None of its Bootstrap 5 surface was kept.

Its own type system: a compressed grotesk for display and for every time on the site, tabular figures throughout, hairline hour rules, warm paper and three track colours that key the grid and the pages alike.
Six SVG drawings written by hand, including a venue plan and an approach drawing that replace the upstream Leaflet map. No photographs, no generated images, no remote requests.

The programme switches day with a keyboard operable tab list and filters the grid by track, with the state readable in the markup and a status line under the controls. Below 860 pixels the grid becomes a chronological list.
